scope: Bounded partial slice: existing persisted server mention/reply notification rows may prepare a reply to their exact source message in the single main chat. This is not automatic sending, a complete incoming-message dispatcher, or full DM/group notification support.

The existing shaped notification-action child window is reused. At most three native fixed row regions carry only bounded opaque notification IDs, row indexes and session tokens. No actor, conversation ID, message body or arbitrary route/URL is sent to that child. Strict two-field requests require an exact physical row hit and a one-shot expiring confirmation from the trusted main frame.

The main renderer resolves immutable account/session/server/channel/message/actor bindings from its existing authenticated feed. It checks current block/ignore/mute state, fresh member and channel overrides, thread parent ACL, send/read/view rights and source membership before navigation and again after asynchronous source loading.

The existing message-window loading/decryption path is reused with an optional backwards-compatible caller-lifetime guard. Source reply selection is discarded on auth, navigation, source, ACL, block/ignore/mute/spam, crypto-device or message lifetime changes. Unknown or undecryptable encrypted bodies are never quoted into a draft.

Existing composer text and files remain in their account/conversation draft. A different reply, in-flight send, group edit, active inline message edit or concurrent draft revision returns a conflict instead of being overwritten. The source notification is marked read only after the exact message opened and reply preparation succeeded.

Canonical P3 shouldSuppressMessagePreview is reused for filter OR pending decisions in overlay chat previews and reply eligibility. Relationship provenance-only changes invalidate the overlay projection even when the friend-array reference is unchanged. Pending disposition neither exposes message text nor creates a spam/quarantine record through these read-only overlay paths.

Settings descriptions now distinguish inbox opening from exact-source reply preparation, automatic sending remains absent, and notification actions keep their existing separate device-only opt-in from mute/deafen, welcome and Go Live controls.
